verdict.rationale: mise's own docs show `mise watch` re-running tasks automatically on file changes. Community users describe a `[hooks]` postinstall section in mise.toml that runs commands such as `uv sync` after `mise install`. Together these give a real but narrow event-to-action mechanism, limited to file changes and install events, with hooks evidenced only by community reports. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a hooks or rules system, a broader set of trigger events (e.g., directory enter/leave hooks), and detail on how event conditions are configured.
